final: SELECT AVG(filtered.site_avg) as avg_face_count, AVG(filtered.site_avg) - (SELECT AVG(CAST(sm.facetfaces AS REAL)) FROM scanmesh sm WHERE sm.facetfaces IS NOT NULL) as above_overall, AVG(filtered.site_avg - filtered.status_avg) as above_status FROM (SELECT sa.site_avg, sta.status_avg FROM (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(CAST(sm.facetfaces AS REAL)) as site_avg FROM scanmesh sm INNER JOIN sites s ON sm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sm.facetfaces IS NOT NULL AND s.entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat) sa INNER JOIN (SELECT site_avg.entrystat, AVG(site_avg.avg_faces) as status_avg FROM (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(CAST(sm.facetfaces AS REAL)) as avg_faces FROM scanmesh sm INNER JOIN sites s ON sm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sm.facetfaces IS NOT NULL AND s.entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat) site_avg GROUP BY site_avg.entrystat) sta ON sa.entrystat = sta.entrystat WHERE sa.site_avg > sta.status_avg) filtered
